record.bible_text: And when David<WH01732> was a little<WH04592> past<WH05674><WTH8804> the top<WH07218> <FI>of the hill<Fi> , behold, Ziba<WH06717> the servant<WH05288> of Mephibosheth<WH04648> met<WH07125><WTH8800> him, with a couple<WH06776> of asses<WH02543> saddled<WH02280><WTH8803>, and upon them two hundred<WH03967> <FI>loaves<Fi> of bread<WH03899>, and an hundred<WH03967> bunches of raisins<WH06778>, and an hundred<WH03967> of summer fruits<WH07019>, and a bottle<WH05035> of wine<WH03196>.
